title: Health Insurance in Daily Practice
subtitle: Dr. Mabrouki & Dr. Alami are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami treat patients from all walks of life every day. But one question concerns them: are their patients properly covered by the AMO?

Between the CNSS, CNOPS, mutual insurance companies, RAMED, dependents, and co-payments... the system is a real puzzle.

A mistake in coverage, a refused reimbursement, and their patients' trust crumbles.

The satisfaction of their patients, their reputation, and their peace of mind rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami treat patients from all walks of life every day. But one question concerns them: are their patients properly covered by the AMO? They discover the basics of the AMO, the managing bodies, and patient rights.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami deepen their knowledge of Law 54.23, mutual insurance companies like MGPAP, and legislative developments. They must master the system to advise their patients.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami are faced with complex situations: dependents, long-term illnesses (ALD), exemptions, complementary mutual insurance. They must optimize their patients' coverage.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami handle disputes: coverage refusals, appeals, contests. They must defend their patients' rights.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami become references in dental coverage. They train young dentists in optimizing reimbursements.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of skills in coverage management and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterTitles.debutant2: Mutual Insurance Companies and their Roles

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami have laid the foundations of the AMO. But the road ahead is still long...

chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Mabrouki and Dr. Alami have accomplished their mission. Coverage is at the heart of the patient relationship.
